title: Analyzing Bias in Swiss Federal Supreme Court Judgments Using Facebook’s Holistic Bias Dataset: Implications for Language Model Training
findings: The descriptor 'JAP' (Jewish American Princess) was found to be statistically biased towards the 'approval' label in the Swiss Judgement Prediction training dataset.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured the statistical bias of 'dispreferred' descriptors, including those related to religion, towards specific judicial outcomes ('approval' or 'dismissal') within the Swiss Judgement Prediction Dataset.
